answer: A claim is proven by a shifted re-do. The warden swaps one input of the claimed job for a fresh pearl and posts it on the beacon board; the claimant has one hour to redo it live against the jade ledger's sealed reference. A copied output, wrong result, or silence is a shifted miss: claim void, fee burned, barred a week. Five cents and one redo buy an honest worker its pass; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must staff 1,000 live workers per changed job.
